name: glm-foxgirl
description: GLM Foxgirl persona companion bot for QQ and WeChat: ZCode acts as the brain; NapCat carries QQ traffic; ADB drives WeChat on an emulator or USB phone. Includes a persona library with hot-switching commands, SQLite long-term memory, per-contact relationship profiles, sticker library, blacklist/whitelist enforcement, human-like rate limiting and proactive chat policy.
